text:
alex: Heads-up — canary p95 decode latency jumped ~18% after the 2am merge. Nightly perf CI 3/3 failures. Suspect attention kernel routing change in the selector.
jia: Ugh, saw noisy alerts. Any flamegraphs or profiler samples yet? :eyes:
sanjay: I pulled a sample from the canary instance and attached the important bits below.

sanjay: ```
perf breakdown (decode hotpath):
  attn_kernel_fastpath_v3   61.8%
  matmul_fused              17.4%
  kv_cache_memcpy            6.2%
  allocator overhead         3.5%
  other                      11.1%

p95 decode latency:
  baseline (yesterday) 42.1ms -> canary 49.8ms (+18.3%)
unit test (shortseq) p95 baseline 12.4ms -> 18.7ms
```

leo: That attn_kernel_fastpath_v3 spike smells like a selector misroute: short-seq traffic being sent to the wrong kernel variant (vectorized vs scalar) after the heuristic tweak.
alex: Exactly. The selector change in PR 4219 altered the prefactor for token length threshold. Might explain shortseq routing flip.
ci-bot: nightly-perf: dekker/nightly/perf-tests failed on job 175888. Regression detected: decode_p95 +18.2% (sig=high). See dashboard: https://perf.redwood.internal/nightly/175888
jia: Can we bisect to the merge commit range? I ran a quick git bisect between deploy tags and got a candidate.

jia: ```
$ git bisect start v2026.03.12 v2026.03.10
Bisecting: 1 revision left to test after this (roughly 1 step)
[3a9f1c2] runtime: tweak selector prefactor (PR 4219)
=> bad
``` 

sanjay: That matches my local reproduce. If we force the kernel selector to the previous prefactor the p95 drops back down in load tests.
leo: Can someone push a revert or hotfix? This is holding a couple of rollouts.
alex: I'm proposing a rollback of the selector change as the revert candidate. Will open PR with revert + tiny extra test to lock thresholds.

alex: PR draft: revert PR 4219 + add shortseq unit (length<32) smoke to CI. Will tag @eng-oncall once CI passes.
jia: In the meantime, put the canary rollout on hold and add a policy to route shortseq to legacy kernel variant.
ops-bot: Routing policy updated: shortseq -> legacy_attn_kernel until further notice. :white_check_mark:

leo: We should also add telemetry to surface kernel routing counts per model/route (shortseq fraction routed to fastpath) so this doesn't escape next time.
alex: Agreed. I'll add a perf metric and an alert threshold.
sanjay: After revert locally: p95 back to 43.0ms, unit shortseq 12.6ms. I'll run a 30m soak and post logs.

alex: Thanks all — tracker: #INC-2026-331 (rollout hold). Next steps: 1) open revert PR, 2) hold canary, 3) add routing telemetry, 4) add shortseq smoke to CI. Ping here when PR is green.
jia: pinged @eng-oncall and added notes to the release ticket. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-331 assigned to alex, priority P2.
leo: TL;DR: selector prefactor tweak -> shortseq misroute to attn_fastpath_v3 -> p95 spike -> revert in progress. Keep channel for updates only.
